scene_properties.data_source: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL; unknown heights and distant urban context generalized

scene_properties.detail_upgrade: PLATEAU Minato 2025 building geometry and source imagery; building bases individually flattened to existing road plane
scene_properties.title_rule: TOKYO TOWER / 東京タワー appears only on frames 1–120, with the complete tower centered. No landmark name on city-only shots.
scene_properties.environment_update: Procedural asphalt/paint/pavement/soil/grass/gravel only; mapped OSM land-use zones; geometric curb/gutter and irregular tree canopies. Aerial photos are reference only, excluded from rendering.
scene_properties.tree_canopy_update: 3313 trees rebuilt with 10 irregular foliage clusters each; original trunk locations retained.
scene_properties.aerial_display_policy: NEVER use aerial or satellite photos, or derived photographic ground color maps, in final visible materials. Reference only. Existing source building facade imagery is retained.
scene_properties.street_detail_status: Added physical roadside details and inferred window framing within 500–650 m of Tokyo Tower. Review cameras are separate from the 15-second title sequence.
scene_properties.tokyo_traffic: OSM one-way direction, left-hand traffic, mixed right-hand-drive vehicles; static review layout.
scene_properties.street_tree_species: Illustrative ginkgo and zelkova, green season; no opaque sphere roadside crowns.
scene_properties.visual_direction: Bright post-rainy-season late morning, approximately 10–11am impression. Green foliage, dry roads, light humid distance haze. Artistic lighting, not an astronomical date reconstruction.
scene_properties.landmark_rebuild: Tokyo Tower + Mori JP Tower shell and perimeter interiors; reference-based visualization with inferred room layouts.
scene_properties.preview: 30s composition study, 12fps; simplified glazing, foliage, reflections; not final-quality rendering.
scene_properties.preview_glazing: Clear transparent stand-in; physical reflection omitted for noise-free camera blocking.
scene_properties.camera_revision: Start on southeast far side, move around the south/west corridor toward the northwest glazing. No sideways window tracking.
scene_properties.interior_reference: https://mdr.tokyotower.co.jp/ — carpet and reflective dark inner walls; detailed fixtures and layout inferred.
scene_properties.photo_reference_status: main.jpg, skywalk.jpg, wall.jpg visually inspected. No reference images used as texture.
scene_properties.window_revision: Nominal ~1m glazing, separate transoms, double pane, polygonal corners, primary/secondary mullions; slope unverified 0deg placeholder.
scene_properties.window_slope_trial: Upper edge outward 5deg, each floor pivots at its own sill. User-directed trial.
scene_properties.camera_story: 0–4s glass floor lean, 4–14s interior passage, 14–20s fly through west glass into Azabudai view. Main Deck 1F.
scene_properties.camera_edit: 28s preview: glass-floor look at existing red tower legs, stationary room sweep, 12mm wide accelerated flight to Mori, then 8s gentle turn back toward Tokyo Tower with deceleration.
scene_properties.skywalk_detail_note: Added near-window support beams and fittings removed at user request. Existing glass floor surround retained. Ground and roof enhancements retained; inferred equipment layout, no aerial imagery.
scene_properties.flush_floor_note: Glass, metal surround, continuous inner and outer gaskets, countersunk fixings and adjacent carpet share Z=145.1m. Carpet trimmed to avoid coplanar overlap.
scene_properties.facade_reference: Pelli Clarke and Partners: pearl-gray glass and four-petal crown; Nihon Sekkei reference photos. Render glass coating parameters are visual approximations, not measured optical values.
scene_properties.full_preview: 52s. Moving cuts: linear motion through exterior and floor cut boundaries. Continuous translation during look-back, then 10s widening city orbit with no stop at the transition.
scene_properties.delivery: Approved 52s camera path, 1920x1080 24fps, Cycles adaptive 48 samples maximum and denoising, shutter .3 frame. Supplied BGM in edit file.
scene_properties.camera_motion_correction: 18-34 seconds restored from approved Glass_Facade_Tower_Return; separate actions for transform and lens; every frame checked against source; all other camera poses retained.
